section: Weapon Experience is just the regular {{Currency|Experience}} earned while equipped with the weapon. You can swap to and use any other weapon during the dive, and the full experience will still count towards the weapon from your load-out. The values are the same for all primary weapons. {| class="mw-collapsible wikitable" |+ Weapon Experience ! Level !! Total Experience !! Experience Required to Advance !!
